title: Evaluating HPK for Running Cloud-Native Workloads on Slurm Clusters
problem: Integrating cloud-native and HPC workloads requires separate resources; leads to inefficient resource partitioning
motivation: Applications increasingly combine cloud-native and HPC processing steps; current separate platforms waste resources and complicate job management
method: HPK framework enabling unmodified cloud-native workload execution on main HPC cluster (Slurm)
key_novelty: Unified execution of cloud-native and HPC workloads on single cluster without resource partitioning
contributions: HPK framework for cloud-native workload support on HPC clusters
Preservation of existing HPC job management and accounting
limitations: Scope limited to evaluation phase; specific to Slurm-based systems
